_about: Hand-reviewed rules that give each IU Bloomington degree program its CIP 2020 code(s). Read by scripts/build_iu_schools.ts; docs/iu-schools.md explains the method.

IU publishes no program-to-CIP list without an IU login, so a CIP comes from IPEDS: the build only accepts a CIP that IU Bloomington (UNITID 151351) reports in IPEDS Completions 2023-24 at the program's own award level. A rule whose CIP fails that check leaves the program unmatched, and the report says why.

basis: 'title' = the CIP title names the same subject; 'degree' = the whole degree is reported under one CIP, so every major in it takes that CIP; 'reviewed' = matched by subject with the reason in 'note'; 'none' = deliberately unmatched, reason in 'note'.

Matching order: degreeRules (exact degree name, optional subject pattern), then subjectRules (exact subject, optional levels and degrees), then a double major 'A/B' takes the union of A and B. A degree program that no rule covers stops the build, so new IU programs must be reviewed here first.
subject = the IU program name with every parenthesis removed and a trailing ' BFA' dropped. levels: B bachelor's, M master's, D doctoral, P post-master's (specialist), A associate's.

campusUnitid: the rare rule whose code IU Bloomington does not report at all, checked instead against the IU campus that reports that school's degrees (a pinned IPEDS extract for that UNITID in sources.json). The report lists every such program.

degreeRules.note: IPEDS 2023-24 shows IU Bloomington's business bachelor's degrees under one code, 52.0101 Business/Commerce, General (2,407 awards); no major-specific business code (for example 52.0301 Accounting or 52.0801 Finance) is reported at bachelor's level, so every BSB major takes 52.0101.
The MBA's majors are concentrations of one degree. IU Bloomington reports 1,026 master's awards under 52.0101 and no 52.0201 (Business Administration) at all.
